mapper.select: select scope_id, plan_id, scope_type, scope_value_id, scope_value_code, scope_value_name, del_flag, remark from wm_stock_taking_scope where plan_id = #{planId} and del_flag = '0' order by scope_id
mapper.insert: insert into wm_stock_taking_scope (plan_id, scope_type, scope_value_id, scope_value_code, scope_value_name, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{planId}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeValueId}, #{scopeValueCode}, #{scopeValueName}, '0', #{remark}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
